reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about dislocation accumulation, energy barriers, and a transition to interface sliding in FCC/BCC HEA multilayers, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support these premises.
premises: Standard interfaces delay plastic flow by accumulating dislocations
Engineered interfaces (orientation/segregants) lower the energy barrier for dislocation transmission
Lowered barrier facilitates a transition to localized interface sliding
Interface sliding governs progressive plastic deformation under sustained load
The transition is observable as a shift from dislocation pile-ups to sliding events
